trickyParts: Dispatch gives a second document, not a new version, when the same artifact name is posted twice (nextArtifactSlug, packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/artifacts.go), so a session uploads its decision document once and appends each later record with docEdit insert after end.

A bearer caller must name its own session (`actor: {kind: "session", id}`) or Dispatch refuses the write with ACTOR_KIND. The first live run lost every record to that, visible only as recordError on the gate's entry.
A Legion pod's LEGION_PROJECT is the daemon's lower-cased project name, and Dispatch answers 404 to any spelling of a project key but the uppercase one, so the record upper-cases it.
A rebuttal and the breaker are answered before either model call, so their entries carry no ruleOutcome; recording only rules-checked calls made the override count structurally zero.
The record is awaited inside the tool_call handler, so its 5 s stop had to be added to the gate's ceiling margin or a timed-out call could outlive the runner's handler ceiling.
